title: Earth Defense Force: Multi-Mod-Loader --- V {version}
tooltip_ko-fi: Donate to help Development of this GUI tool
tooltip_language_dropdown:
Select the language for the EDF Modloader GUI.
Changes will take effect. Best after restarting the application.
tooltip_loadout_planner___mission_databa:
Opens website for Loadout Planner and Mission Database.
Useful for planning loadouts and viewing mission drop details.
tooltip_play_this_game: Launches the selected EDF game using the detected platform (Steam or Epic).
tooltip_current_platform:
Toggles between launching via Steam or Epic Games.
Used for games that support both platforms.
tooltip_online_progress_tracker: Opens the online tracker to monitor EDF game completion and progress stats.
tooltip_update_modloader_ba: Downloads latest EDFModLoader and plugin ZIP from GitHub.
tooltip_update_mods: Auto-updates installed mods from GitHub or other sources.
tooltip_build_tables: Compiles MCD data and builds tables using HAKKEN EXE.
tooltip_repair_tables: Repairs broken or missing weapon/mission tables.
tooltip_mods_panel: Toggles the Mods Panel GUI for enabling/disabling installed mods.
tooltip_mods: Open the folder for Mod_config_data.json files (used by MML)
tooltip_patches: Open the folder for .patch files used by EDF MML
tooltip_plugins: Open the folder for additional mod plugins (.py/.dll/etc)
tooltip_save_folder_41: Opens your EDF 4.1 save folder (user documents)
tooltip_save_folder_5: Opens your EDF 5 save folder (user documents)
tooltip_save_folder_6: Opens your EDF 6 save folder (user documents)
tooltip_import_r2z: Imports a local .r2z mod profile file for processing.
tooltip_request_drop_off_now:
Submits your code to fetch the requested content for the selected EDF game.
No real data is sent/uploaded or downloaded.
tooltip_show_credits: Displays a scrolling credit roll for the EDF MML contributors.
tooltip_run_all_bat_files:
Runs all .bat files found in the specified directories.
Useful for executing batch scripts related to building the source code.
tooltip_game_dropdown: Select which Earth Defense Force game to view mod hosting links for.
tooltip_discord_mml_form: Post issues, suggestions, or feedback for the EDF Modloader GUI on this Discord .
tooltip_documentation___wiki: Access the EDF Modding documentation and wiki pages.
maybe_birbs_guide_on_how_to_mod_edf: Maybe Birb's Guide on How to Mod EDF
tooltip_maybe_birbs_guide_how_to_mod_edf: View Maybe Birb's guide on how to mod EDF on Steam.
tooltip_source_code: Link to the github for Blue Amulets Modloader
tooltip_official_edf_en_on_x: Visit the official EDF EN profile on X for updates and news.
tooltip_official_edf_jp_on_x: Visit the official EDF JP profile on X for updates and news.
tooltip_official_edf_reddit: Visit the official EDF Reddit community to discuss mods, strategies, and connect with other players.
tooltip_official_edf_discord: Join the official EDF Discord server to connect with the community and discuss mods, or LFGs.
tooltip_official_edf_wiki: Visit the official EDF Wiki for detailed game information and guides.
tooltip_request_code_input:
Enter your request code to fetch the requested content.
No real data is sent/uploaded or downloaded.
